svg.title: Discrete cumulative counts identify exact central observations
svg.desc: A discrete table has values zero, one, two and four with frequencies two, three, four and one. Cumulative counts are two, five, nine and ten. The ten ordered observations are zero, zero, one, one, one, two, two, two, two and four. Positions five and six contain one and two, so the exact median is three halves. The weighted total is fifteen and the exact mean is also three halves. The mode is two because its frequency is four. The two central observations are distinctly highlighted in the full ordered strip.
